title: Twelve Shots in Four Holes
title_candidates: Nine Points Clear: The Trophy Conversation Shifts
theme: Alex Baker donated 12 shots in four front-nine holes at Littlestone — triple, double, triple, quad — and a further quad at the 8th, while Mullin survived his own mid-round trouble with a birdie at the 7th to post 41 Stableford points (best in field, again) and extend the Trophy lead to 9 and the Jacket to 12.
opening_hook: Open by referencing Baker's R1 blow-up pattern as a preview, then land the R2 front nine: 12 shots over par in four holes is not a continuation of that pattern — it is an escalation. Then cover Mullin's parallel wobble and recovery.
foreshadow: Baker's H2-5 implosion (12 shots over par in 4 holes) arrives before H8 — foreshadowing one more quad still to come in the same round.
Mullin's triple-double-bogey run at H4-6 briefly threatens to let the field back in — setting up whether he can arrest the slide before it costs him.

competition_state.name: Trophy
competition_state.note: Mullin extended his overnight lead of 3 to 9 — Baker's front-nine disaster (12 shots over par, H2-5) built the bulk of the gap; Mullin's best-in-field 41 pts did the rest. Baker remains second but 9 behind with two rounds left.

competition_state.name: Green Jacket
competition_state.note: Mullin's R2 gross of 14 over par (best in field) extended the overnight Jacket lead from 5 to 12 shots over Jon Baker; with two rounds remaining the Jacket is close to settled.

competition_state.name: Wooden Spoon
competition_state.note: Jon Baker remains last, but the gap to Williams narrowed from 4 to 2 points as Williams posted a worse round (27 pts) than Baker (29 pts) for the day.

players.arc: Ran into trouble mid-round — triple at H4 (one of the hardest, SI2), double at H5, bogey at H6 — but answered with a birdie at the par-5 7th, then closed with another birdie at H18 to post 41 Stableford points: best in field for the second consecutive round.

Front nine at Littlestone produced the round's defining episode: triple at H2 (SI4), double at H3, triple at H4 (one of the hardest, SI2), quad at H5 (one of the easiest, SI16) — 12 shots over par in four holes — followed by a further quad at H8; he steadied with six holes without a net-dropped shot from H13-18, finishing on 35 pts.
Posted 29 Stableford points — the same as his R1 total — and remains last in the Trophy standings, though the Wooden Spoon gap to Williams narrowed to 2 as Williams had a worse round.
27 Stableford points — worst in the field this round — but remains 2 ahead of Jon Baker in the Wooden Spoon standings.

venue_notes: Littlestone is TEG's 2nd visit to this venue — a remote links on Romney Marshes, designed by the architect of Royal St George's and refined by Braid and MacKenzie. Its exposed, flat character punishes front-nine decisions. Baker's implosion at H2-5 encapsulates what Littlestone does to a round when concentration lapses.

payoffs.seed: Baker's H2-5 implosion (12 shots over par in 4 holes) arrives before H8
payoffs.resolves_in: H8 — quadruple bogey at the par-4 8th
payoffs.payoff: The front-nine damage was not done at H5 — a further quad at H8 confirmed the pattern was systemic, not isolated, before Baker finally righted himself on the back nine.

payoffs.seed: Mullin's triple-double-bogey run at H4-6 briefly threatens to let the field back in
payoffs.payoff: Mullin answered the wobble immediately with a birdie at the par-5 7th, arresting the slide and confirming that his R1 performance was not a one-round anomaly.
